Given it functions in a very similar way (but briefer) to the Quick Reference Playmat supplied by V:EKN, I can't really see why you couldn't use it now, in official tournaments. It's not providing any sort of coaching. And players are entitled to keep notes on the game [1.4 vekn.net/tournament-rules ] and if the first "notes" they wrote down were the five phases of the game, I can't see any judge clamping down on them doing that, because that would be weird.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
I can't see any reason to disallow this as long as
- it is correct
- it is not taking all the space

I would recmomend not making it the same size as a card, in order to avoid people shuffling back in their decks.

Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body: You can have a copy of the rulebook with you, so a turn order reminder card/sheet is totally fine.
